lines.zh: 侧着身子走，沙上留一串小坑。
lines.en: I walk sideways, leaving a row of small pits in the sand.

lines.zh: 浪退下去，我赶着去翻那块石头。
lines.en: The wave pulls back, and I hurry to flip that stone.

lines.zh: 潮池边缘滑，我的壳磕了一下。
lines.en: The tide pool rim is slick; my shell knocks against it.

lines.zh: 八条腿一起动，比横着看要快。
lines.en: Eight legs move at once, faster than I look from the side.

lines.zh: 海草缠住螯尖，我拖着它走了几步。
lines.en: Kelp snags my claw tip, and I drag it a few steps.

lines.zh: 我去看看那枚被浪推上来的贝壳。
lines.en: I go to inspect the shell the surf pushed ashore.

lines.zh: 沙太干，我换个湿一点的地方走。
lines.en: The sand is too dry; I move to a wetter stretch.

lines.zh: 走过湿沙，脚印很快被水抹平。
lines.en: I cross wet sand, and the water erases my tracks.

lines.zh: 我先横移半步，再往前探。
lines.en: I sidestep half a pace, then probe forward.

lines.zh: 靠近水线的沙最软，走着舒服。
lines.en: The sand near the waterline is softest under my legs.

lines.zh: 我举着一只螯，像举着一面小盾。
lines.en: I hold one claw up like a little shield.

lines.zh: 浪声太响，我走一步停一下。
lines.en: The surf is loud, so I take a step and pause.

lines.zh: 壳上沾的沙，走一路掉一路。
lines.en: Sand stuck to my shell falls off with every step.

lines.zh: 我沿着退潮留下的湿痕走。
lines.en: I follow the wet line the ebb tide left behind.

lines.zh: 我夹起一块湿沙，往壳上抹。
lines.en: I pinch up wet sand and smear it on my shell.

lines.zh: 沙蟹的洞在那边，我绕开。
lines.en: A sand crab's burrow is over there; I go around.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋进沙里，只留眼睛。
lines.en: I bury myself in the sand, leaving only my eyes out.

lines.zh: 沙粒硌着壳底，挺舒服。
lines.en: Grains of sand press under my shell, and I like it.

lines.zh: 一个泡泡从口器冒出来，破了。
lines.en: A bubble rises from my mouthparts and pops.

lines.zh: 我数着浪，一共打上来七次。
lines.en: I count the waves: seven have broken so far.

lines.zh: 那只海鸥飞得太低，我不动。
lines.en: That gull flies too low, so I stay perfectly still.

lines.zh: 埋着的时候，我能听见沙下的水。
lines.en: Buried, I can hear water moving under the sand.

lines.zh: 螯上还留着昨晚夹过的海藻味。
lines.en: My claws still smell of the kelp I held last night.

lines.zh: 沙面被风推成一棱一棱的。
lines.en: The wind combs the sand into little ridges.

lines.zh: 我把两只螯收在胸前，省点力气。
lines.en: I tuck both claws against my chest to save strength.

lines.zh: 潮水退远时，我会想念那点凉。
lines.en: When the tide draws far out, I miss its coolness.

lines.zh: 壳缝里卡着一小片碎贝壳。
lines.en: A shard of shell is wedged in the seam of my carapace.

lines.zh: 有东西在沙下动，我侧耳听。
lines.en: Something stirs beneath the sand; I tilt to listen.

lines.zh: 我吐出一串泡，看它们漂走。
lines.en: I blow a string of bubbles and watch them drift off.

lines.zh: 月亮上来时，沙会变成灰蓝色。
lines.en: When the moon rises, the sand turns grey-blue.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的沙面了，退半步。
lines.en: You stepped on my patch of sand — half a step back.

lines.zh: 你手里那桶水，是给我准备的吗？
lines.en: Is that bucket of water meant for me?

lines.zh: 我举起螯，只是打招呼，不是要夹。
lines.en: I raise my claw in greeting, not to pinch.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我，我看不清潮线。
lines.en: Your shadow covers me and hides the tide line.

lines.zh: 蹲下来，我才看得见你的脸。
lines.en: Kneel down, and I can finally see your face.

lines.zh: 你靴子上沾的沙，跟我家的一样。
lines.en: The sand on your boots matches the sand back home.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是因为你比我高太多。
lines.en: I stare because you are so much taller than me.

lines.zh: 别拿手指逗我，我会当真夹。
lines.en: Don't tease me with a finger; I will truly pinch.

lines.zh: 你身上有海的味道，去过很远的地方？
lines.en: You smell of the sea — have you been far?

lines.zh: 我往沙里缩了缩，又探出眼睛。
lines.en: I shrink into the sand, then poke my eyes out again.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一道，我先往沙里钻。
lines.en: A crack in my shell — I dive into the sand first.

lines.zh: 这一下把沙都震起来了。
lines.en: That blow shook the sand loose.

lines.zh: 我缩起八条腿，护住软的腹部。
lines.en: I curl my eight legs to shield my soft belly.

lines.zh: 螯还被夹着，我抽不回来。
lines.en: My claw is still caught; I can't pull it free.

lines.zh: 疼得我横着乱走，撞上了石头。
lines.en: The pain sends me sideways into a stone.

lines.zh: 壳上的沙掉了一层，凉飕飕的。
lines.en: A layer of sand falls off my shell, and I feel exposed.

lines.zh: 我吐了一串泡，想挡住视线。
lines.en: I blow a string of bubbles to block the view.

lines.zh: 洞口就在两步外，我爬得很慢。
lines.en: My burrow is two steps away, and I crawl slowly.

lines.zh: 螯壳被敲裂，泡泡从我嘴里漏出来。
lines.en: My claw shell is cracked, and bubbles leak from my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋到只剩壳背。
lines.en: I bury myself until only my shell shows.

lines.zh: 是鱼腥味？我横着挪过去了。
lines.en: Is that fish smell? I sidestep toward it.

lines.zh: 你晃的那条小鱼，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: I see that little fish you're dangling quite clearly.

lines.zh: 生鳕鱼的味道，让我螯都张开了。
lines.en: The smell of raw cod makes my claws open wide.

lines.zh: 我跟着味道走，没顾上潮水。
lines.en: I follow the smell and forget the tide.

lines.zh: 你放低一点，我够不到你的手。
lines.en: Lower it a bit; I can't reach your hand.

lines.zh: 海带也行，我不挑。
lines.en: Kelp will do too — I'm not picky.

lines.zh: 那股腥味一飘，我腿就自己动了。
lines.en: When that fishy scent drifts by, my legs move on their own.

lines.zh: 我把螯举高，等你松手。
lines.en: I raise my claws and wait for you to let go.

lines.zh: 这味道比潮池里的螃蟹强多了。
lines.en: This smells far better than anything in the tide pool.

lines.zh: 你要是逗我，我可会一直跟着。
lines.en: If you're teasing, I'll just keep following you.

lines.zh: 撞到你腿上，我的壳嗡了一声。
lines.en: I bump your leg and my shell hums.

lines.zh: 你走得太急，我被顶得横移两步。
lines.en: You walk too fast; I get shoved two steps sideways.

lines.zh: 别踢，我只是站在你脚边。
lines.en: Don't kick — I'm only standing by your foot.

lines.zh: 壳磕在石头上，掉了点沙。
lines.en: My shell knocks a stone and sheds some sand.

lines.zh: 我横着没看清，撞上了你的桶。
lines.en: Walking sideways, I didn't see your bucket and hit it.

lines.zh: 你踩下来的影子，比浪还快。
lines.en: Your shadow falls faster than any wave.

lines.zh: 让一让，我要回潮池那边。
lines.en: Step aside; I'm heading back to the tide pool.

lines.zh: 我撞歪了，先稳住八条腿。
lines.en: I've been knocked askew; let me steady all eight legs.

lines.zh: 你的脚跟像一堵会走的墙。
lines.en: Your heel is like a wall that walks.

lines.zh: 我贴着你脚边过，别突然转身。
lines.en: I'll pass by your foot — don't turn suddenly.

lines.zh: 我在洞口敲螯，等一个回音。
lines.en: I tap my claw at the burrow mouth, waiting for an answer.

lines.zh: 她横着绕我转，沙上两圈痕。
lines.en: She circles me sideways, leaving two rings in the sand.

lines.zh: 潮水正好，我们把洞挖深些。
lines.en: The tide is right; we dig the burrow deeper.

lines.zh: 我把最光滑的那枚贝壳推给她。
lines.en: I push the smoothest shell toward her.

lines.zh: 两只蟹并排埋进沙里，只露眼。
lines.en: Two crabs bury side by side, only eyes showing.

lines.zh: 她嫌我的洞太浅，我又挖了一尺。
lines.en: She thinks my burrow is too shallow, so I dig another foot.

lines.zh: 螯碰螯，算是说定了。
lines.en: Claw against claw — that settles it.

lines.zh: 我们守着同一片湿沙，谁也不让。
lines.en: We guard the same wet sand and yield to no one.

lines.zh: 她走在前面，我横着跟在后头。
lines.en: She leads, and I follow sideways behind her.

lines.zh: 夜里涨潮前，我们得把洞口堵好。
lines.en: Before the night tide, we must seal the burrow mouth.

lines.zh: 我夹起那枚贝壳，塞进壳缝。
lines.en: I pick up the shell and wedge it in my carapace seam.

lines.zh: 掉下来的鱼，我拖着走。
lines.en: I drag away the fish that fell.

lines.zh: 这粒沙太亮，我收着。
lines.en: This grain of sand is too bright; I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 我夹住海草，像夹一条绳子。
lines.en: I grip the kelp as if it were a rope.

lines.zh: 桶边的碎贝壳，归我了。
lines.en: The broken shells by the bucket are mine now.

lines.zh: 我举着捡来的东西，横着跑。
lines.en: I run sideways, holding what I found aloft.

lines.zh: 太重了，我换一只螯再夹。
lines.en: Too heavy — I switch to the other claw.

lines.zh: 这枚螺壳正好补上洞口的缺口。
lines.en: This spiral shell fits the gap at my burrow mouth.

lines.zh: 我捡到一块被浪磨圆的玻璃。
lines.en: I find a piece of glass worn round by the surf.

lines.zh: 东西掉了，我在沙里扒了半天。
lines.en: I drop it and paw through the sand for ages.

lines.zh: 那东西在动，我先把螯张开。
lines.en: Something is moving; I open my claws first.

lines.zh: 它踩进我的湿沙，我记下了。
lines.en: It stepped into my wet sand, and I noted that.

lines.zh: 泡泡先吐出去，探探它的反应。
lines.en: I spit a bubble first to test its reaction.

lines.zh: 距离够近了，我横着绕到侧面。
lines.en: Close enough — I sidestep around to its flank.

lines.zh: 它比我大，可我的壳是硬的。
lines.en: It's bigger than me, but my shell is hard.

lines.zh: 我埋进沙，只留一只眼睛看它。
lines.en: I sink into the sand, one eye fixed on it.

lines.zh: 它背对着潮池，路被我堵住了。
lines.en: Its back is to the pool; I'm blocking the way.

lines.zh: 我先敲一下螯，算是警告。
lines.en: I clack my claw once as a warning.

lines.zh: 那影子的动作，跟我盯的鱼一样。
lines.en: That shadow moves like the fish I stalk.

lines.zh: 沙下有个洞，我能从下面过去。
lines.en: There's a burrow below; I can come up beneath it.

lines.zh: 我竖着走，让它估不准距离。
lines.en: I walk straight at it so it can't judge my distance.

lines.zh: 泡泡糊在它脸上，它就慢了。
lines.en: A bubble bursts on its face, and it slows.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面挪，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I slide along the sand, making as little sound as I can.

lines.zh: 它在找我在哪，我埋在沙里。
lines.en: It's searching for me while I lie buried.

lines.zh: 螯举到一半，等它先扑。
lines.en: I raise one claw halfway and wait for it to lunge.

lines.zh: 我绕到它影子里，那是最暗的地方。
lines.en: I slip into its shadow, the darkest spot around.

lines.zh: 潮水在退，它退路越来越窄。
lines.en: The tide is going out, and its escape narrows.

lines.zh: 我数它的步子，第三步就动手。
lines.en: I count its steps; on the third, I move.

lines.zh: 它踩碎了我的洞口，我不再等。
lines.en: It crushed my burrow mouth; I stop waiting.

lines.zh: 沙面下的震动，比眼睛更早告诉我。
lines.en: The vibration under the sand tells me before my eyes do.

lines.zh: 一螯夹住它的脚踝，我往后拽。
lines.en: One claw clamps its ankle, and I haul backward.

lines.zh: 我横着撞过去，壳先到。
lines.en: I charge sideways, shell first.

lines.zh: 夹一下就跑，沙里是我的地盘。
lines.en: Pinch once and run — the sand is my ground.

lines.zh: 它弯下腰，我正好够到它的手。
lines.en: It bends down, and its hand comes within reach.

lines.zh: 泡泡喷在它眼睛上，我趁乱夹。
lines.en: Bubbles hit its eyes, and I pinch in the confusion.

lines.zh: 我吊在它裤脚上，八条腿乱蹬。
lines.en: I hang from its trouser leg, eight legs flailing.

lines.zh: 壳撞出闷响，我的手也麻了。
lines.en: My shell lands with a thud, and my claw goes numb.

lines.zh: 它退一步，我跟着横移一步。
lines.en: It steps back; I sidestep to match.

lines.zh: 夹空了，我赶紧钻回沙里。
lines.en: I miss the pinch and dive back into the sand.

lines.zh: 这地方沙子松，我借力弹起来。
lines.en: The sand is loose here; I spring off it.

lines.zh: 浪把我推上滩，壳里还存着水。
lines.en: A wave shoves me ashore, water still in my shell.

lines.zh: 我从沙里钻出来，抖掉一身沙。
lines.en: I climb out of the sand and shake it off.

lines.zh: 天刚亮，湿沙上多了我这只蟹。
lines.en: Dawn breaks, and there's one more crab on the wet sand.

lines.zh: 潮池里空着，我占了这块石头。
lines.en: The pool is empty; I claim this stone.

lines.zh: 第一件事，是先挖一个洞。
lines.en: First thing: dig a burrow.

lines.zh: 海风把我的泡泡吹散了。
lines.en: The sea wind scatters my bubbles.

lines.zh: 我还不认得这片滩，先横着走一圈。
lines.en: I don't know this shore yet; I'll walk one loop.

lines.zh: 沙子灌进壳缝，我得先抖干净。
lines.en: Sand fills my shell seams; I must shake it out.

lines.zh: 水线在退，我跟上去。
lines.en: The waterline is retreating, and I follow it.

lines.zh: 这里有海草味，应该能住。
lines.en: There's kelp scent here; this should do.

lines.zh: 壳被烤得发烫，我往湿沙里退。
lines.en: My shell grows hot, and I back into the wet sand.

lines.zh: 从石头上摔下来，壳先着地。
lines.en: I fall from the stone and land on my shell.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳缝，我拼命往上爬。
lines.en: Water floods my shell seams, and I claw upward.

lines.zh: 沙子炸起来，我的洞塌了一半。
lines.en: Sand blasts up, and half my burrow collapses.

lines.zh: 那支箭钉在壳上，晃了两下。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my shell and wobbles twice.

lines.zh: 一股冷意钻进壳里，腿都僵了。
lines.en: A cold feeling seeps into my shell and stiffens my legs.

lines.zh: 潮池里没鱼了，我只能啃海草。
lines.en: No fish left in the pool; I gnaw on kelp.

lines.zh: 雷落在滩上，我的壳嗡嗡响。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the shore, and my shell rings.

lines.zh: 下面没有沙，也没有水，只有空。
lines.en: Below me there is no sand, no water, only nothing.
